title: Consensus-layer application-awareness
description: Student selected: "The consensus engine will detect the clock drift during the commit phase and automatically roll back the transaction to maintain consistency.". This reveals a fundamental misunderstanding of State Machine Replication (SMR).
trigger_evidence: Diagnostic quiz attempt on Question q-1790872689618-0. Selected erroneous hypothesis: The consensus engine will detect the clock drift during the commit phase and automatically roll back the transaction to maintain consistency..

remediation_steps.title: Deconstruct the Counter-Example
remediation_steps.explanation: Consider what happens when this assumption is applied to an edge case. The invariant breaks because intermediate states are not preserved.
remediation_steps.verified_quote: A loop invariant must satisfy initialization, maintenance, and termination.

remediation_steps.title: Formal Invariant Formulation
remediation_steps.explanation: Notice that each stack frame allocates independent local registers and return pointers.
remediation_steps.code_example:
def recurse(n):
    if n <= 0: return
    # Each invocation creates an isolated O(1) frame
    recurse(n - 1)
remediation_steps.verified_quote: Activation records are pushed to the execution call stack sequentially.
remediation_steps.source_ref: Computer Systems: A Programmer Perspective, Page 242

remediation_steps.title: Self-Explanation & Invariant Verification
remediation_steps.explanation: Verify that both base conditions and induction hypotheses hold for all N >= 1.
remediation_steps.verified_quote: Inductive step proves truth for N+1 from N.
remediation_steps.source_ref: Discrete Mathematics and Its Applications, Page 315
